_comment: SHR-004. Every canon contradiction this tree currently carries, acknowledged with an owner and the PR that will close it. This is an AUDIT-ONLY record: PR 01 detects, PR 02 and PR 03 fix. fix/shr-active-identity retired the six retired canon bundle::archived-unmarked findings (each file now carries a Superseded banner) and the four cites-archived findings on commands/team.md and references/{connector-advisory,harness-translation-map,two-strikes-rule}.md (each citation now names a live surface). fix/shr-compatibility-boundary (SHR-027) retired shiroe/release/claim_gate.py::cites-archived: the gate now excludes the archived canon bundle from its scan the same way it already excluded docs/adr/, so it derives no behaviour from a superseded surface and no longer names one. Drift is an error in both directions — a finding that appears without an entry here fails the build (NEW), and an entry here that no longer reproduces also fails the build (DROPPED), so fixing a contradiction without retiring its acknowledgement is caught too. Finding ids are (surface, rule), never line numbers, so reflowing a paragraph does not invent a finding.
